title: Deleted data patch returns
summary: Delete an entry, save the map and reopen it. The deleted patch is back.
sampleReport: In Mindustry's map editor, I delete a data patch and save the map. When I close and reopen the same map, the deleted patch comes back. I expected the deletion to stay saved.
assistance: This run received guidance to include both save confirmations in its selected evidence. The earlier report-only attempt confirmed 3/5. No source diagnosis or historical fix was supplied.
scope: Persistence of an editor-accepted data-patch entry. Gameplay effects of that entry and other save scenarios were not measured.
reductionNote: Bounded reduction removed one action. The resulting 30-action trigger was independently confirmed on five fresh profiles; it is not a proof of the shortest possible replay.

title: Saving a Target Dummy crashes the game
summary: Place a Target Dummy in the editor and save. The game crashes.
sampleReport: Mindustry crashes when I save a map after placing a Target Dummy in the editor. Loading the saved map also gives an error. The dummy and map should survive saving and reopening.
modelNote: GPT-5.6 Terra · medium proposal, later MAX validation
assistance: The AI proposed the patch from the pre-fix source and recorded crash. Later validation used a separately planned and frozen save/reopen check. Earlier incomplete validation attempts remain in the evidence package.
scope: The unchanged 12-action crash trigger plus 12 additional candidate checks establish saving, reopening and the retained dummy. An unavailable upstream test archive still blocks full validation.
reductionNote: The trigger was reduced from 15 actions to 12. Candidate validation executes those same 12 actions, followed by 12 separately frozen save/reopen checks. Additional checks are not counted as trigger reduction.

title: Entered color changes on readback
summary: Enter ff0300 for a colored tile, confirm and reopen the picker. It reads ff0200ff.
sampleReport: In the Mindustry editor, entering ff0300 in the Colored Wall or Colored Floor picker gives me ff0200ff when I confirm and reopen it. The hex color changes instead of keeping the value I entered.
assistance: An operator supplied the prior investigator's final 29 actions and selected checkpoints. The first selection omitted wall placement and picking; adding those existing images enabled five fresh confirmations. No historical fix or source diagnosis was supplied.
scope: ff0300 input/readback in both pickers and a placed-and-picked Colored Wall. Other reported values and adjacent floor placement are outside this replay. The AI candidate did not fix the defect.
reductionNote: No reduction was attempted. The supplied 29-action trace stayed unchanged through fresh confirmation and candidate validation.
